what: LHmom: Parameter Estimation and Total Calculations of Linear Higher-Order Moments (LH-Moments) — LHmom-package
title: LHmom: Parameter Estimation and Total Calculations of Linear Higher-Order Moments (LH-Moments) — LHmom-package
text: Computes sample theoretical Linear Higher-Order Moments (LH-moments) implements parameter estimation various statistical distributions, including Generalized Extreme Value (GEV), Generalized Logistic (GLO), Generalized Pareto (GPA), Generalized Normal (GNO), Pearson Type III (PE3), Kappa distributions. also provides analytical tools Wang's goodness--fit test. design, parameterization, output structures package closely follow style conventions 'lmomco' package ensure familiar consistent interface users accustomed L-moment calculations R.
